answer.answer: PMJDY provides universal banking services for every unbanked household, including basic savings bank accounts, access to need-based credit, remittances facility, insurance, and pension [E02]. From the Ministry of Finance, the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is another programme that finances income-generating micro-enterprises by facilitating micro credit/loans up to Rs. 20 lakhs to non-farm sector income generating activities [E01].
